summary: Client-side read-only guard: refuse non-GET and denylisted cart/checkout/slot/order mutations (including updateItems and reserveSlotMutation with no consent escape); stop without retry on PerimeterX/Akamai challenges. Challenge errors name the response shape without echoing it. Cart changes are link-only outside HTTP.
reason: v1 is read-only by owner decision; the web app auto-fires MergeAndGetCart and other mutations, and a bot-flagged session must not be hammered. Consented-write escape removed when writes became link-only.
validated_outcome: All non-GET and denylisted orchestra operations blocked with no consent escape. updateItems and reserveSlotMutation POSTs always refuse. Bot challenge stop on 412/418/429/456/EOF without retry.
